subject: Co-branded runtime licensing & support — Nova Assist OEM inquiry
messages:
From: Emma Ruiz <emma.ruiz@novapartner.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Arjun Singh <arjun.singh@novapartner.com>
Date: 2026-09-22T16:12:00-07:00
Subject: Interest in co-branded runtime licensing for Nova Assist

Hi Priyom / Laura,

Thanks for taking a look — I lead integrations at Nova Partner and we are evaluating options to embed a high-performance LLM runtime inside our flagship product (Nova Assist). We liked Redwood's runtime benchmarks and the controls you offer for private deployments.

High level:
- Use case: in-product assistant surfaced across the web app (text generation + structured output).
- Target launch: early Q2 2027.
- Estimated steady-state: ~500k inference calls / month (peak 3x).
- Requirements: co-branded experience (logo + small attribution), admin UI to show model version, enterprise SSO, customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM) for key material, and an option for an air-gapped/on-prem package for a few customers.

Can you share a term sheet that covers: licensing model (OEM runtime vs reseller), per-seat / per-call vs reserved capacity pricing, basic SLA numbers, support tiers, and IP/attribution guidance? Also attaching a short product outline so you can see where it will live.

Appreciate a quick read — can we do a 45-minute kickoff next week? We prefer mornings PT.

Best,
Emma
Head of Integrations, Nova Partner
Attachment: nova_product_outline.pdf

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Ruiz <emma.ruiz@novapartner.com>, Arjun Singh <arjun.singh@novapartner.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-22T18:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Interest in co-branded runtime licensing for Nova Assist

Emma / Arjun — great to meet you virtually, and excited about the possibility of partnering. High level here and proposed next steps.

TL;DR — we can support a co-branded runtime embed with two primary commercial paths:
- OEM runtime license (embed Redwood binary/runtime into partner product; annual license + capacity commits + optional private deployment package)
- Managed reserved capacity (Redwood Dedicated) with co-branding and dashboarding; simpler ops but less air-gapped

What I attached: redwood-oem-term-sheet-v1.pdf (draft) and a short integration diagram (integration-diagram.png).

Immediate asks from our side:
- Confirm target customers who need air-gapped installs vs those who can use managed infra
- Expected monthly token/request volumes and concurrency distribution
- Any mandated contractual items from Nova legal (we'll share a draft NDA/term sheet back)

Operational notes:
- Attribution: we support co-branded UI elements and an admin toggle for showing the runtime version, but we do not permit rebranding of the model itself (model + pedigree stays attributed to Redwood).
- Keys & data: we support KMS/HSM integrations and a private control plane option; telemetry can be configured to minimize PII surface (we'll need an explicit data processing addendum).
- SLA: for OEM installs we provide an installation runbook; for managed Dedicated deployments we offer SLA-backed latency/uptime targets (details in the term sheet).

Next step: propose a 45-minute kickoff Wed 09/29 or Thu 09/30 between 9–11am PT. Laura will lead commercial details; Vivek will help scope the infra/ops work and validate KMS options.

If you can send any must-have contractual clauses from legal ahead of the call that helps speed the review. We can turn around redlines within ~3 business days after receiving them.

Thanks — looking forward.

Priyom Das
Head of Partnerships | Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood-oem-term-sheet-v1.pdf; integration-diagram.png

From: Arjun Singh <arjun.singh@novapartner.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Emma Ruiz <emma.ruiz@novapartner.com>, Legal (Nova Partner) <legal@novapartner.com>
Date: 2026-09-24T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Interest in co-branded runtime licensing for Nova Assist

Thanks Priyom — attaching a short DD workbook and our initial redlines for the term sheet.

Quoting your note below:
> we do not permit rebranding of the model itself (model + pedigree stays attributed to Redwood).

Two quick follow-ups from legal/ops:
- Indemnity & liability caps: Nova's general counsel wants to understand standard Redwood positions here and if there's flexibility for enterprise customers.
- KMS/HSM: we need a clear technical spec for customer-managed keys and whether the private control plane can be fully isolated (no telemetry out) for air-gapped customers.
- SLA targets: please confirm latency percentiles and RTO for failover if we use Dedicated reserved capacity.
- Pricing: please provide both a reserved capacity SKU estimate for 500k calls/month and a per-call blended rate for pilot volumes.

Attached: novapartner-due-diligence.xlsx and nova_redlines.docx.

Can you route the redlines to legal and infra and get back with an internal response we can discuss on the kickoff? We confirmed 09/29 9:30am PT works for our team.

Best,
Arjun
Director of Product Partnerships, Nova Partner
Attachments: novapartner-due-diligence.xlsx; nova_redlines.docx

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Emma Ruiz <emma.ruiz@novapartner.com>, Arjun Singh <arjun.singh@novapartner.com>
Date: 2026-10-02T15:34:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Nova Partner redlines — need legal & infra input

Laura / Vivek — forwarding Nova's redlines and due-diligence workbook. Key asks from their side are above (indemnity, KMS isolation, SLA numbers, reserved SKU pricing). Please treat this as high priority — their timeline is tight for a Q2 2027 launch.

Action items (please reply-all with estimates by EOD Thu 10/07):
- Laura: draft commercial response with two pricing options (pilot blended per-call; committed reserved capacity for steady state with three-year discount tiers).
- Vivek: confirm whether our private control plane can be configured with no outbound telemetry for air-gapped installs and outline any work/assumptions and HSM/KMS support matrix.
- Legal (cc'd Priyom): review Nova redlines for any non-standard liability/indemnity asks and propose language we can accept vs. escalate.

I'll own the kickoff on 09/29 and will take notes — but need the above by next week to present to Nova.

Thanks — Priyom
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
